messages:
Ethan: quick RFC follow-up: we need a short, canonical handoff for token->lease to avoid double-admit and billing races.

Maya: agree. Keep token fastpath 1 RPC. If upgrade needed, edge returns provisional_id and async confirms to central.

Noor: confirm batching is key. Edge confirmer should batch every 100ms or 200 requests, with idempotent PUT /confirm(provisional_id)->{leased|revoked}.

Raj: telemetry asks: provisional_age_ms, confirm_latency_p99, provisional_expiry_count, fallback_to_token_rate. Alert if provisional_expiry_count > 1% of admits over 5m.

Ethan: eviction plan: soft-notice (grace_ms) then hard revoke. Expose lease_revoked events and per-tenant eviction_count.

Maya: owners: eng-platform Maya+Ethan, eng-sre Raj. Plan: spike 1w, prototype 2w, canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Docs + runbook before canary.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Meeting scheduled Thu 10:00am PT "Admit handoff scrub". Reminder 24h.

Noor: I'll draft the follow-up RFC with API sketches and a short chaos test matrix (central down, confirm reorder, clock skew).

Ethan: perfect. keep messages short in the RFC, add checklist for billing dedupe and dashboards. :thumbsup:
